name: Idle-Aware Engine Pause Recovery
changes: Engine-pause recovery now requires actual transfer work: a live SAB Queue slot or non-zero raw engine remaining bytes.
An empty private SAB engine may settle into aggregate Paused/idle state without NewzDeck repeatedly reasserting Resume or displaying an engine recovery warning.
The bounded coherent Active-snapshot bridge also requires transfer-work evidence, so a genuinely drained queue cannot retain stale Active cards merely because SAB idles as Paused.
Diagnostics distinguishes benign idle SAB-paused state from a real pause mismatch that has transfer work waiting.
All v3.6.17 canonical Downloads-state, no-hidden-live-job, pause-intent, and Smart Import recovery behavior remains preserved.
regression_guards: No Resume reassertion occurs when SAB has no Queue slots and zero remaining transfer bytes.
Unexpected SAB Pause still triggers recovery when transfer work exists and NewzDeck user intent is Running.
A real NewzDeck user Pause remains authoritative regardless of queue workload.
A drained queue cannot be kept Active by the pause bridge.
v3.6.17 visible-job canonicalization, Remaining invariants, and dead-runtime Smart Import reclaim remain unchanged.
v3.6.16 verified Remove/Cancel and Active continuity remain preserved.
